answer: Split an identity's standing into shards held across independent domains: to earn, a head must assemble a quorum of endorsements from jade-sealed domain badges it cannot cheaply co-locate. Each badge is earned separately, with a cooling period that grows as the juniper canopy of held badges thickens, so correlation cannot be parallelized. A farmer wanting k heads must repeat this slow grove-building for each one, paying wall-clock time k times over. Domains sharing infrastructure fold into one, collapsing the quorum and returning the head to probation until diversity is proven.
